items.summary_zh: 诉讼称，美国环保署数十年来未能根据《清洁水法》解决地表水中的阿特拉津污染问题。一起新诉讼要求联邦法官下令特朗普政府解决由内分泌干扰物农药阿特拉津造成的广泛污染——该物质的检测浓度经常达到威胁野生动物和人类健康的水平。根据最近对联邦记录的审查，这种与癌症有关的化学物质目前已污染了美国大陆近25%的河流，总长度约86万英里。 这些水道覆盖了全国20%以上的地表饮用水取水口，以及超过67.5万口私人和商业水井。继续阅读……

items.title: Unprecedented late-summer mega-heatwave over the Yangtze River Basin in 2024: dynamical fingerprint of extreme anomalous atmospheric circulation variability
items.title_en: Unprecedented late-summer mega-heatwave over the Yangtze River Basin in 2024: dynamical fingerprint of extreme anomalous atmospheric circulation variability
items.title_zh: 2024年长江流域夏季末史无前例的强热浪：极端异常大气环流变率的动力学特征
items.summary_en: Record-breaking heatwaves arise from the interplay between long-term warming and transient atmospheric circulation anomalies, yet the mechanisms by which atmospheric circulation variability contributes to unprecedented heatwave severity remain an active area of investigation. Here, we investigate the unprecedented late-summer 2024 super heatwave with concurrent dry conditions (LS24) over the Yangtze River Basin (YRB), which produced the largest late-summer temperature anomaly during 1979–2024. We show that the record-breaking magnitude of LS24 was primarily associated with an extreme realization of a recurrent Eurasian circulation mode superimposed on a warmer background. In the full-record Empirical Orthogonal Function analysis, the event coincided with the largest positive phase of the leading mode of late-summer Eurasian circulation variability, manifested as a trans-Eurasian Rossby wave train that established persistent East Asian ridging and a heat-dome environment over the YRB through enhanced subsidence, radiation, and moisture divergence. The constructed flow analog method partitions the 4.8 °C total anomaly into a 26%–29% long-term background, a 50%–57% circulation-associated component and a 17%–21% residual; the circulation component alone accounts for 71%–77% of the detrended anomaly. Seasonal forecast ensembles further show that the ensemble-mean response produced only modest warming and failed to reproduce the observed wave-train structure, whereas similar extreme circulation states emerged within member-to-member circulation variability and were associated with stronger YRB warming. These results highlight that, under a warming climate, rare atmospheric circulation extremes can strongly modulate regional heat severity under concurrent dry conditions and represent a fundamental challenge for seasonal prediction of unprecedented climate extremes.
items.summary_zh: 创纪录的热浪源于长期变暖与瞬态大气环流异常之间的相互作用，但大气环流变率如何导致前所未有的热浪强度，这一机制仍是当前研究的热点领域。 本文研究了2024年夏末长江流域（YRB）发生的一场伴有干旱条件的史无前例的超级热浪（LS24），该事件产生了1979–2024年间最大的夏末气温异常。 我们表明，LS24创纪录的强度主要与一种周期性欧亚环流模态的极端表现有关，该模态叠加在更温暖的背景上。在全记录经验正交函数分析中， 该事件恰与夏末欧亚环流变率主导模态的最大正相位重合，表现为一条横跨欧亚大陆的罗斯贝波列，该波列通过增强下沉、辐射和水汽散度，在长江流域形成了持久的东亚高压脊和热穹顶环境。 通过构建的流场类比法，将4.8 °C的总异常值分解为26%–29%的长期背景、50%–57%的环流相关分量以及17%–21%的残差； 仅环流分量就占去趋势异常值的71%–77%。季节预报集合分析进一步表明，集合平均响应仅产生了温和的变暖，且未能再现观测到的波列结构；而成员间环流变异性中出现了类似的极端环流状态，并伴随黄河流域更强烈的变暖。 这些结果强调，在气候变暖的背景下，罕见的大气环流极端事件在伴随干旱条件下会显著调节区域热浪强度，并为前所未有的气候极端事件的季节预报带来了根本性挑战。

items.title: The green paradox of on-demand adaptation: how digital delivery amplifies urban carbon and material burdens
items.title_en: The green paradox of on-demand adaptation: how digital delivery amplifies urban carbon and material burdens
items.title_zh: 按需适应的“绿色悖论”：数字化交付如何加剧城市碳排放和材料负担
items.summary_en: With the rapid expansion of digital on-demand services, urban residents increasingly rely on platforms as a primary adaptation to extreme heat. However, the resource implications of this shift—specifically the ‘green paradox’ where protective behavior accelerates material and energy consumption—remain poorly quantified. Drawing on transaction-level food-delivery records for 100 Chinese cities (2017–2019, 2023), we show that heat shocks trigger nonlinear surges in delivery demand, concentrated in midday peaks. By integrating these orders with a system-wide accounting of last-mile transport and packaging-related emissions, we quantify how behavioral responses propagate through urban metabolic systems. We find that delivery-related CO emissions rise more than twice as fast as demand volume, reflecting the combined influence of last-mile transport and packaging-related emissions. This elasticity gap widens in digitally dense cities with carbon-intensive grids and inefficient packaging standards. We formalize this imbalance as the Urban Green Paradox: individual heat avoidance is achieved by shifting burdens to material-intensive infrastructures. These results reveal that digital adaptation amplifies urban resource intensity under current regimes. Targeted interventions, including enforcing reusable packaging and fleet electrification, offer pathways to realign digital convenience with sustainable resource management.
items.summary_zh: 随着数字化按需服务的快速扩张，城市居民越来越依赖各类平台作为应对极端高温的主要方式。然而，这种转变带来的资源影响——特别是“绿色悖论”（即防护行为反而加速了物质和能源消耗）——目前仍缺乏充分的量化研究。 基于中国100个城市（2017–2019年、2023年）的交易级外卖订单记录，我们发现高温冲击会引发外卖需求的非线性激增，且这种激增主要集中在午间高峰时段。 通过将这些订单数据与针对“最后一公里”运输及包装相关排放的全系统核算相结合，我们量化了行为反应如何在城市代谢系统中传播。 我们发现，外卖相关的二氧化碳排放量增长速度是需求量的两倍多，这反映了“最后一公里”运输和包装相关排放的综合影响。在数字化程度高、电网碳强度大且包装标准低效的城市中，这种弹性差距进一步扩大。 我们将这种失衡形式化为“城市绿色悖论”：个人为避暑所采取的措施，实际上是将负担转移到了材料密集型基础设施上。这些结果表明，在当前体制下，数字化适应加剧了城市资源密集度。有针对性的干预措施——包括强制推行可重复使用包装和车队电气化——为将数字便利与可持续资源管理重新协调提供了途径。

items.summary_en: New study reveals dramatic population drops in fish, cephalopods and more after Deepwater Horizon disasterMarine life in the Gulf of Mexico plummeted by about 60% after BP’s 2010 Deepwater Horizon oil spill and has still not fully recovered, according to a new study.The April 2010 explosion of an offshore drilling unit 50 miles off the Louisiana coast triggered the largest marine oil spill in history, releasing 134m gallons of oil into the ocean. According to the study published on Monday in PNAS, the disaster – which also killed 11 people and injured 17 others – led to the “sudden, severe and persistent declines in the abundance” of marine life for more than a decade. items.title: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_en: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_zh: 热带森林破碎化加剧导致极端高温现象加剧
items.summary_en: Deforestation, as one of the most pressing global environmental challenges, can intensify local temperature extremes through altering surface properties (e.g. albedo, roughness and evapotranspiration) and the associated land–atmosphere interactions. Prior studies have largely focused on the effects of forest cover changes at the grid scale, whereas the impact of subgrid-scale changes in forest fragmentation has received relatively limited attention. Utilizing satellite-based forest fragmentation index (FFI) data and the ERA5-Land reanalysis data, we investigate impacts of FFI changes in tropical forests on local extreme temperature indices, including the annual mean and maximum values of daily maximum temperature (TXm and TXx, respectively). Our results show that increasing FFI (i.e. forests becoming more fragmented) can significantly intensify extreme temperatures, with each unit increase in FFI corresponding to increases of 0.35 °C –1.14 °C for TXm and 0.83 °C –2.85 °C for TXx. These phenomena are mainly attributed to fragmentation-induced shifts in surface energy partitioning, which reduce latent heat flux and enhance sensible heating. The sensitivities of extreme temperatures to increasing FFI vary by region, with its strength being strongest in the Congo Basin (1.14 °C unit−1 for TXm and 2.85 °C unit−1 for TXx) but weaker in the Amazon basin (0.58 °C unit−1 for TXm and 1.21 °C unit−1 for TXx) and Southeast Asia (0.35 °C unit−1 for TXm and 0.83 °C unit−1 for TXx). These regional differences result from that background hydroclimatic conditions and land–atmosphere coupling strength can modulate the effect of forest fragmentation changes on extreme temperatures. These findings highlight the important role of increasing forest fragmentation in amplification of local temperature extremes, with implications for developing forest management strategies aimed at enhancing resilience to extreme climate events under ongoing warming.
items.summary_zh: 森林砍伐作为最紧迫的全球环境挑战之一，会通过改变地表特性（如反照率、粗糙度和蒸散量）以及相关的陆地-大气相互作用，加剧当地的极端气温。 先前的研究主要关注网格尺度上森林覆盖变化的影响，而亚网格尺度森林破碎化变化的影响则相对较少受到关注。 利用基于卫星的森林破碎化指数（FFI）数据和 ERA5-Land 再分析数据，我们研究了热带森林中 FFI 变化对当地极端温度指数的影响，包括日最高温度的年均值和最大值（分别表示为 TXm 和 TXx）。 研究结果表明，FFI的增加（即森林破碎化程度加深）会显著加剧极端温度，FFI每增加一个单位，TXm和TXx分别上升0.35 °C–1.14 °C和0.83 °C –2.85 °C。这些现象主要归因于森林破碎化导致的地表能量分配变化，这种变化会降低潜热通量并增强显热加热。 极端温度对 FFI 增加的敏感性因地区而异，其中刚果盆地最为显著（TXm 为 1.14 °C/单位，TXx 为 2.85 °C/单位），而亚马逊盆地 （TXm 为 0.58 °C/单位，TXx 为 1.21 °C/单位）以及东南亚（TXm 为 0.35 °C/单位，TXx 为 0.83 °C/单位）则较弱。 这些区域差异源于背景水文气候条件和陆地-大气耦合强度能够调节森林破碎化变化对极端温度的影响。这些发现凸显了森林破碎化加剧在放大局部温度极端事件中的重要作用，这对制定旨在增强在持续变暖背景下应对极端气候事件韧性的森林管理策略具有重要意义。

items.title: Hurricane warning maps are improving, but a dangerous problem remains
items.title_en: Hurricane warning maps are improving, but a dangerous problem remains
items.title_zh: 飓风预警图虽在不断改进，但一个危险的问题依然存在
items.summary_en: A new study reveals that improved hurricane forecast graphics may help people identify threatened areas without making them more likely to recognize the danger or take protective action. Researchers also found that a widespread misunderstanding of the hurricane cone persists, highlighting a potentially dangerous gap between accurate forecasts and public preparedness.
items.summary_zh: 一项新研究表明，改进后的飓风预报图虽然有助于人们识别受威胁区域，但未必能提高他们对危险的认知或促使他们采取防护措施。研究人员还发现，人们对飓风锥的普遍误解依然存在，这凸显了准确预报与公众防灾准备之间存在潜在的危险差距。
